title: Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) in GeoFormat.Parse
description: GeoFormat.Parse uses a regular expression with nested quantifiers. A long, malformed coordinate string causes catastrophic backtracking and blocks the thread. Any endpoint that passes user input to GeoFormat.Parse is exploitable.
remediation: Upgrade to Teide.Geo 2.0.0. There is no patch for 1.x. 2.0.0 brings breaking changes: see its release notes.
